# Alexander Huth

> Personal website of Alexander Huth, a Berlin-based organic growth consultant, advisor, and fractional leader focused on SEO, Content Marketing, and AI-driven discovery. Beyond consulting, the site is a personal archive of his interests: films, music, concerts, photography, travel, coffee, and lists.

Alexander Huth (born 1987 in Neubrandenburg, Germany) has worked in SEO and organic growth since 2009. He began his career at the Berlin company builder Rocket Internet, moved to agency work at AKM3 (Performics) in 2012, and joined the travel startup Omio in 2013. There he scaled the organic function to cover 30 markets in 20 languages, leaving in 2019 as Director of Organic Acquisition. He has worked independently since 2019, advising companies of every size — from early-stage startups to publicly listed companies — as well as agencies, venture capital firms, investors, and boards, and taking on interim and fractional leadership engagements. He teaches Search Marketing and Mobile Marketing as a guest lecturer at XU Exponential University in Potsdam. He studied German Studies and Communication Studies at Freie Universität Berlin, and lives in Berlin-Wannsee.

This site is a hand-built static Jekyll site with no tracking, no cookies, and no third-party embeds. The background color changes on every page load.
